description: Cluster of four small, near-black, matte wrinkled Ajwa dates (Madinah type) cut out on transparent; cut-out derived from the Glenov Brankovic product shot, cropped tight and background removed.
Small near-black, soft wrinkled Ajwa dates on white display steps against a clean white background, no text or logos; cropped from the original studio shot.

Wooden bowl of large, plump, deeply wrinkled amber-to-dark-brown Medjool dates on transparent; cut-out derived from the Pixabay 'Dates Medjool' photo (two loose dates beside the bowl removed from the mask).
Large plump wrinkled Medjool dates in a walnut-wood bowl with a few loose dates on pale wooden boards and linen, warm natural light, no text or logos; photo is uncropped (1280px Pixabay size).

Heap of long, very dark black-brown, finely wrinkled Safawi/Kalmi-type dates on transparent; cut-out derived from the Husien Bisky plate photo (plate, cloth and board removed). Photographer's own alt text calls them Medjool, but shape and colour read as Safawi/Kalmi.
Plate of long, near-black wrinkled Safawi/Kalmi-type dates on linen cloth and wood board with a few loose dates, dark slate backdrop, no text or logos; cropped from the original portrait shot.

Transparent cut-out derived from the source photo below: Plate of long, slender, wrinkled red-brown dates with calyx caps on a beige cloth and dark slate (photographer tagged them generically as 'medjool dates'); slender tapering shape, maroon-brown wrinkled skin and calyx caps match Mabroom, not round dark Ajwa; variety is a visual match, not labelled by the photographer.

Plate of long, slender, wrinkled red-brown dates with calyx caps on a beige cloth and dark slate (photographer tagged them generically as 'medjool dates'); slender tapering shape, maroon-brown wrinkled skin and calyx caps match Mabroom, not round dark Ajwa; variety is a visual match, not labelled by the photographer.

Transparent cut-out derived from the source photo below: Six golden-amber plump dates with glossy crinkled skin on a white block, palm-frond tip at top-left, bright white studio background; golden-amber honey-glow, soft crinkly skin and medium plump shape match Sukkary; variety is a visual match, not labelled by the photographer.

Six golden-amber plump dates with glossy crinkled skin on a white block, palm-frond tip at top-left, bright white studio background; golden-amber honey-glow, soft crinkly skin and medium plump shape match Sukkary; variety is a visual match, not labelled by the photographer.

Transparent cut-out (bowl only) derived from the Rauf Alvi source photo: small glass bowl of plump-oval, amber-golden-brown, fairly smooth glossy dates (visual match for Zahdi/Zahidi; variety not named by the photographer).

Small glass bowl of dates plus a few loose dates on a clean light-pink background, shot from above; small plump-oval amber-golden-brown dates with fairly smooth glossy skin match Zahdi/Zahidi; variety is a visual match, not labelled by the photographer (tags: dates, ramadan, brown).

Cut-out (rembg) derived from a Wikimedia Commons photo of 11 whole Deglet Noor dates: slender, oblong, glossy translucent amber-brown skin; three dates cropped by the original frame were erased so none look chopped. Commons structured data and description identify the variety as Deglet Noor (Kebili, Tunisia).

description: Natural photo of Deglet Noor dates on a white plate (plain documentary shot, cool white balance, a few dates touch the frame edge). Variety is explicitly labelled Deglet Noor on Commons, so this is the most verifiable Deglet Noor image found.
attribution: M. Dhifallah, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dattes_deglet_from_Biskra.jpg)

description: Cut-out derived from the Medina market photo: the source is a frame-filling heap with no natural outline, so rembg could not isolate it; this is a soft-edged oval crop of the heap on transparent (edge dates are truncated), not a true rembg cut-out.

Close-up of a heap of two-tone dates at a market in Medina, Saudi Arabia (taken 2011): red-brown/golden bodies with pale cream-tan tips, medium-long, as expected for Suqai (Sagai). Variety is not labelled by the photographer; matched by look and Madinah origin.

Clean rembg cut-out of a white textured bowl heaped with dark plum-brown, plump, glossy-wrinkled soft dates; cut-out derived from the Unsplash bowl photo. Look is consistent with Safawi (very dark, soft, plump) but the photographer does not name the variety.

Natural portrait photo of a white bowl of dark soft wrinkled dates on a warm terracotta backdrop (Surat, India; titled 'Date Dry Fruit in White Bowl'). Matches Safawi by colour/texture/plumpness (not the smaller, rounder, matt Ajwa) but variety is unlabelled.
